The '''Reog's Regiment''' was one of the largest independent [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] unit in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was composed of two [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaughts]], many [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] and [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], two [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] and 3,000 [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. The regiment struck a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facility in a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] system, but [[Lorka]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], hired a rival mercenary fleet to attack [[Reog]]'s fleet in retaliation. He and his regiment were then hired by [[Grruna Thu]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] leader of the [[Shrook Clan]], to attack the [[Hakks]], a rival clan, in retaliation for destroying their outpost on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. The mercenaries were ultimately overwhelmed in the battle.<ref name="Dangerous Covenants" />
